request.style: English, Male solo rock voice with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, uplifting and steady mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I made my sin known to you
Did not cover up my guilt
I said I will confess my transgressions
And you forgave the guilt of my sin

[Chorus]
I will instruct you and teach you the way
You should go I will counsel you
I will watch over you with care
You are my hiding place from trouble

[Verse]
Let all the faithful pray to you
At a time when you may be found
When the mighty waters overflow
They will not reach him in that moment

[Chorus]
I will instruct you and teach you the way
You should go I will counsel you
I will watch over you with care
You are my hiding place from trouble

[Bridge]
Do not be like a horse or a mule
Without understanding bit and bridle
Many are the sorrows of the wicked
But trust in the Lord for steadfast love

[Chorus]
I will instruct you and teach you the way
You should go I will counsel you
I will watch over you with care
You are my hiding place from trouble

[Outro]
Rejoice in the Lord and be glad
Shout for joy you who are upright
